name: DRESS UP BY DESIGN Girls Pink 3 Piece 'Fairy Set' Dress-Up Costume
description: Girls cerise pink 'Fairy' dress-up costume. The flared skirt has tiers of tulle with green ribbon trims. The top tier has tulle and chiffon petal shapes with flower petals caught between them. It has an elasticated waistband and silky feel lining. The pink wings have appliquéd flowers with glittery green stems and elasticated shoulder straps. To complete the set there is a wand to match the wings.
